title: 球面支承安裝~Spherical bridge-bearing installation
focus: 以約束配置、轉角與摩擦力矩、預設偏移與灌漿墊層，讓球面支承如設計般轉動與滑動~Restraint layout, rotation and friction moment, presetting and bedding grout so a spherical bearing rotates and slides as designed
summary: 從支承配置與熱位移出發，量化球面支承的轉角需求、滑動材料承壓、曲面摩擦力矩與偏心，再處理工廠預設偏移、墊層灌漿、運輸固定件拆除、型式試驗、現場位移指標與累積滑移磨耗，最後以萊茵河上兩座斜張橋的 120 MN 級球面支承更換與新建案例，說明頂升更換與交接紀錄。~Starting from bearing layout and thermal movement, quantify a spherical bearing's rotation demand, sliding-material pressure, curved-surface friction moment and eccentricity, then handle factory presetting, bedding grout, removal of transport fittings, type testing, movement indicators and accumulated sliding wear, closing with jacking replacement and handover records through 120 MN class spherical bearings on two Rhine cable-stayed bridges.

units.anchor: 固定、單向、雙向支承配置~Fixed, guided and free layout
units.title: 約束配置與熱位移~Restraint layout and thermal movement
units.mechanism: 一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。溫度、混凝土潛變乾縮與預力縮短讓梁以固定點為原點伸縮，距固定點越遠的支承滑移量越大；球面支承把轉動交給球冠曲面、把滑動交給上方平面滑板，兩種自由度各自由不同滑動面負責。配置錯誤時，熱位移被束制，水平力直接打進橋墩。~A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point; the other bearings are guided (sliding only longitudinally) or free (sliding in all horizontal directions), and transverse restraint is concentrated in a few guided bearings. Temperature, concrete creep and shrinkage and prestress shortening make the deck expand and contract about the fixed point, so bearings farther from it slide more. A spherical bearing assigns rotation to its curved calotte and sliding to the flat plate above it, so each freedom has its own sliding surface. With a wrong layout, thermal movement is restrained and horizontal force is driven straight into the piers.
units.model: 熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼—混凝土複合梁 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、支承距固定點 L = 240 m、有效溫差 ΔT = 60°C，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm，約為平均位置 ±86 mm；若把固定點從聯中央移到端部，L 變為 480 m，滑移量加倍到約 346 mm。數值為教學假設。~Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a steel–concrete composite girder with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, a bearing L = 240 m from the fixed point and an effective range ΔT = 60°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm, about ±86 mm from the mean position; moving the fixed point from mid-unit to the end makes L = 480 m and doubles the travel to about 346 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。~Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin.
units.failure: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。~Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps.
units.misconception: 固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。~The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is.
units.practice: 支承一覽表要附箭頭示意圖標出每個支承的可動方向與固定點，曲線橋與斜橋的導向方向須以指向固定點的弦線決定，並由設計者在施工圖上簽認後才進行製造。~The bearing schedule must include an arrow diagram showing each bearing's free directions and the fixed point; for curved and skewed bridges the guide direction follows the chord toward the fixed point, and the designer signs it off on the construction drawings before fabrication.

units.anchor: 設計轉角 θ~Design rotation θ
units.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求~Vertical reaction and rotation demand
units.mechanism: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。設計轉角必須把結構計算值加上製造與安裝允差，因為支承座板很難做到完全水平。~Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. In a spherical bearing the convex calotte slides inside a concave seat, so it accommodates rotation in any direction while the contact pressure distribution stays almost unchanged, its main advantage over pot or elastomeric bearings. The design rotation must add fabrication and installation tolerances to the structural value, because bearing plates are never set perfectly level.
units.model: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。取 w = 120 kN/m、L = 60 m、E = 34 GPa、I = 12 m⁴，EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m²，θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad；加計 0.005 rad 安裝允差後約 0.0076 rad，規格取 0.01 rad。數值為教學假設，允差依適用規範核定。~For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). With w = 120 kN/m, L = 60 m, E = 34 GPa and I = 12 m⁴, EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m² and θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad; adding a 0.005 rad installation allowance gives about 0.0076 rad, specified as 0.01 rad. Values are teaching assumptions; tolerances follow the governing code.
units.verify: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。~Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin.
units.failure: 若轉角需求低估，球冠滑到凹面邊緣後上座板與下座板金屬接觸（硬點），反力集中在邊緣，可能壓壞滑動材料、使座板翹曲並在梁底或墩帽造成局部壓碎。~If rotation demand is underestimated, the calotte runs to the edge of the concave seat and the upper and lower plates touch metal to metal, concentrating the reaction at the edge, which can crush the sliding material, warp the plates and locally crush the girder soffit or pier cap.
units.misconception: 球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。~A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
units.practice: 支承規格書要分列結構轉角、允差與總設計轉角，並註明繞哪兩個軸；製造商圖面須標示金屬接觸前的最大轉角與剩餘間隙，作為現場檢查的比對值。~The bearing specification lists structural rotation, tolerance and total design rotation separately and names both axes; the manufacturer's drawing must show the maximum rotation before metal contact and the remaining clearance as a reference for site inspection.

units.anchor: 球冠與滑動材料承壓~Calotte and sliding-material pressure
units.title: 球冠、滑板與滑動材料~Calotte, sliding plates and sliding materials
units.mechanism: 球面支承由下座板（凹面）、球冠（凸面，常為鍍硬鉻或包覆不鏽鋼）與上滑板組成，兩個滑動面各嵌一層滑動材料：傳統為 PTFE，近年也有改質超高分子量聚乙烯與專利滑動材料，與拋光不鏽鋼板配對並以矽脂潤滑。滑動材料嵌在凹槽中受側向圍束，承壓能力因此遠高於自由狀態；它的容許壓力決定了球冠直徑與整個支承的平面尺寸，進而決定墩帽上需要的支承面積與邊距。~A spherical bearing has a lower plate with a concave surface, a convex calotte (usually hard-chromed or clad in stainless steel) and an upper sliding plate; each of the two sliding surfaces carries a sliding-material layer, traditionally PTFE and more recently modified ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene or proprietary materials, mated with polished stainless steel and lubricated with silicone grease. Recessed in a groove, the material is laterally confined and carries far more pressure than when free; its allowable pressure fixes the calotte diameter and the plan size of the bearing, and hence the bearing area and edge distances needed on the pier cap.
units.model: 所需滑動面積 A = N/σ_allow。N = 20 MN、σ_allow = 45 MPa 時 A = 20/45 ≈ 0.444 m²，圓盤直徑 D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.75 m；若改用承壓約為兩倍的滑動材料（σ_allow = 90 MPa），A ≈ 0.222 m²，D ≈ 0.53 m。數值為教學假設，非任何產品的設計值。~Required sliding area A = N/σ_allow. With N = 20 MN and σ_allow = 45 MPa, A = 20/45 ≈ 0.444 m² and the disc diameter is D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.75 m; a sliding material with about twice the pressure capacity (σ_allow = 90 MPa) gives A ≈ 0.222 m² and D ≈ 0.53 m. Values are teaching assumptions, not product design values.
units.verify: 審查滑動材料的型式試驗或歐洲技術評估文件（ETA）、不鏽鋼板表面粗糙度與硬度、球冠鍍層厚度與材料證明；出廠前量測凹凸面曲率半徑與配合間隙，確認滑動材料嵌入深度、外露高度與潤滑凹坑符合圖面。~Review the sliding material's type tests or European Technical Assessment, the stainless sheet roughness and hardness, the calotte coating thickness and mill certificates; before delivery measure the curvature radii and fit of the concave and convex surfaces and confirm the material's recess depth, protrusion and lubrication dimples against the drawings.
units.failure: 滑動材料長期在高壓與頻繁往復滑動下會冷流外擠：萊茵河諾伊維德的萊夫艾森橋原有盆式支承，其滑板中的 PTFE 就因頻繁移動被側向擠出而必須更換，外擠後摩擦升高、金屬面互磨。~Under high pressure and frequent reciprocating movement a sliding material can cold-flow out of its recess: the original pot bearings of the Raiffeisen Bridge at Neuwied on the Rhine had to be replaced because the PTFE in their sliding plates was pressed out laterally by frequent movement, raising friction and letting metal surfaces rub.
units.misconception: PTFE 不會磨損，所以滑動支承裝好之後就是免維護的。~PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed.
units.practice: 採購規範要求滑動材料具型式試驗與累積滑移能力的證明，不鏽鋼面不得塗裝或焊濺，運送與安裝期間以護蓋保護滑動面；任何現場打磨或焊接都必須遠離滑動面並經監造同意。~The procurement specification requires type-test evidence and a stated accumulated-sliding capacity for the sliding material; stainless surfaces must not be painted or weld-spattered and stay covered during transport and installation, and any site grinding or welding must keep clear of sliding surfaces with the inspector's approval.

units.anchor: 曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR~Curved-surface friction moment
units.title: 摩擦力矩、偏心與水平力~Friction moment, eccentricity and horizontal force
units.mechanism: 球面支承轉動時，球冠必須在曲面上滑動，摩擦力 μN 作用在曲率半徑 R 上，形成抵抗轉動的力矩，等同把豎向反力的作用線偏移一段距離 e；上滑板在平面上滑動時，摩擦力 μN 則以水平力傳入墩帽與錨栓。摩擦係數隨壓力升高而降低、隨低溫與首次啟動而升高，因此設計要同時檢查常溫與低溫情境。這些力矩與水平力雖小於主反力，卻足以控制墩帽邊緣、梁底加勁與錨栓設計。~When a spherical bearing rotates the calotte must slide on its curved surface, so the friction force μN acting at radius R creates a moment that resists rotation, equivalent to shifting the line of action of the vertical reaction by an eccentricity e. When the upper plate slides on the flat surface, μN enters the pier cap and anchors as a horizontal force. Friction falls as pressure rises and rises at low temperature and at first breakaway, so design checks both normal and cold conditions. These moments and forces are small compared with the main reaction but can govern pier-cap edges, girder stiffeners and anchors.
units.model: 曲面摩擦力矩 M = μ·N·R，等效偏心 e = M/N = μ·R，平面滑動水平力 H = μ·N。取 N = 20 MN、μ = 0.03、R = 1.2 m：M = 0.03×20×1.2 = 0.72 MN·m，e = 0.036 m = 36 mm，H = 0.6 MN；低溫啟動 μ = 0.05 時 H 升為 1.0 MN、e 為 60 mm。數值為教學假設。~M = μ·N·R, e = M/N = μ·R and H = μ·N. With N = 20 MN, μ = 0.03 and R = 1.2 m: M = 0.03×20×1.2 = 0.72 MN·m, e = 0.036 m = 36 mm and H = 0.6 MN; at a cold breakaway μ = 0.05, H rises to 1.0 MN and e to 60 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在墩帽與梁底局部分析中把反力置於偏心 e 處並施加 H，檢查支承下混凝土局部承壓、邊距與錨栓剪力；核對支承製造商提供的設計摩擦係數與其型式試驗溫度範圍是否涵蓋橋址最低溫。~In local analyses of the pier cap and girder soffit place the reaction at eccentricity e and apply H, checking concrete bearing pressure, edge distances and anchor shear; confirm the manufacturer's design friction coefficient and the temperature range of its type tests cover the site's minimum temperature.
units.failure: 若把球面支承視為零力矩、零水平力的理想鉸，墩帽邊緣可能出現劈裂裂縫，梁底加勁板在偏心反力下局部屈曲；多支承同時低溫啟動時，累加的摩擦水平力可能超過短墩的設計剪力。~Treating a spherical bearing as an ideal hinge with no moment and no horizontal force can lead to splitting cracks at pier-cap edges and local buckling of girder bearing stiffeners under the eccentric reaction; when several bearings break away together in cold weather, the summed friction can exceed the design shear of a short pier.
units.misconception: 球面支承完全不傳遞彎矩，可以當成理想鉸接點。~A spherical bearing transmits no moment at all and can be treated as an ideal pin.
units.practice: 圖面要標示設計摩擦係數、偏心 e 與水平力 H，並由結構設計者確認墩帽與梁底已按此設計；短墩或高墩頂的多支承情況，要明確寫出摩擦力的累加或分配假設。~Drawings state the design friction coefficient, eccentricity e and horizontal force H, and the structural designer confirms the pier cap and girder soffit are designed for them; for short piers or multiple bearings on one pier top, state explicitly how friction forces are summed or distributed.

units.title: 預設偏移與溫度修正~Presetting and temperature correction
units.mechanism: 支承在工廠組裝時，上滑板相對下部會預先偏移一段距離，使橋梁在長期平均狀態下滑板回到中央，左右兩側都保留相同的滑移量。偏移量取決於安裝當時的梁體有效溫度與設計參考溫度之差，以及安裝後才發生的潛變、乾縮與預力縮短；因此預設值在製造前就要指定，並附一張依安裝溫度修正的表。製造商通常規定預設只能在工廠完成，現場調整須由受訓人員依程序執行。~At factory assembly the upper sliding plate is offset from the lower part so that, in the long-term average state, the plate returns to centre with equal travel left on both sides. The offset depends on the difference between the girder's effective temperature at installation and the design reference temperature, plus the creep, shrinkage and prestress shortening that occur after installation; it must therefore be specified before fabrication together with a correction table by installation temperature. Manufacturers normally require presetting in the factory, with any site adjustment done only by trained personnel following a procedure.
units.model: 預設 Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L。混凝土梁 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵ /°C、L = 180 m、安裝時梁溫 30°C、參考 15°C：溫度部分 1.0×10⁻⁵×180,000×15 = 27 mm；潛變乾縮 ε_cs = 3.0×10⁻⁴，得 54 mm；合計 81 mm，偏向遠離固定點。若在 10°C 安裝，溫度部分變為 −9 mm，總預設 45 mm。數值為教學假設。~Preset Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L. For a concrete girder with α = 1.0×10⁻⁵ /°C, L = 180 m, 30°C girder temperature at installation and a 15°C reference: thermal part 1.0×10⁻⁵×180,000×15 = 27 mm; creep and shrinkage ε_cs = 3.0×10⁻⁴ give 54 mm; total 81 mm, set away from the fixed point. Installing at 10°C makes the thermal part −9 mm and the total preset 45 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以埋設或貼附在梁體的溫度計取得有效梁溫（不是氣溫），在固定錨栓前依修正表確認預設刻度，拍照記錄刻度與溫度讀值；若安裝溫度超出表列範圍，暫停並請設計者與製造商重算。~Obtain the effective girder temperature from embedded or surface-mounted thermometers, not air temperature, confirm the preset scale against the correction table before anchors are fixed, and photograph the scale with the temperature reading; if the installation temperature is outside the table, stop and ask the designer and manufacturer to recalculate.
units.failure: 預設方向弄反或忽略潛變乾縮時，滑板在數年內就滑到一側極限，上座板撞上止擋，橋梁剩下的熱位移只能靠擠壓墩頂或伸縮縫吸收，導致止擋剪斷或墩身開裂。~A reversed preset, or one that ignores creep and shrinkage, lets the plate run to one end within a few years; the upper plate hits its stop and the remaining thermal movement is forced into the pier top or the expansion joint, shearing the stop or cracking the pier.
units.misconception: 安裝當天的氣溫就等於梁體溫度，可以直接拿來設定預設量。~The air temperature on installation day equals the girder temperature and can be used directly to set the preset.
units.practice: 預設修正表與方向箭頭要印在支承本體與施工圖上，錨栓固定前設為監造查驗點，由施工、監造與製造商代表三方確認刻度、梁溫與方向後才可灌漿。~Print the preset correction table and direction arrow on the bearing and the drawings, and make anchor fixing a hold point: the contractor, inspector and manufacturer's representative jointly confirm scale, girder temperature and direction before grouting.

units.anchor: 墊層灌漿與運輸固定件~Bedding grout and transport fittings
units.title: 墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移~Bedding grout, anchors and load transfer
units.mechanism: 支承先以調整螺栓或墊片定位高程與水平，錨栓或錨筋插入預留孔，再以流動性高、無收縮的砂漿填滿下座板與墩帽之間的墊層，讓豎向力均勻傳入混凝土。墊層若有空洞，下座板會像跨越空洞的板一樣受彎，滑動材料壓力不均，甚至讓球冠局部卡住；製造商一般建議墊層不宜過厚並使用流動性砂漿。運輸時用來鎖住上下座板的固定件必須在灌漿硬化、梁體落座之後切除，否則支承被鎖死成固定點。~The bearing is first set to level and elevation on regulating screws or shims, anchor dowels are placed in preformed pockets, and a flowable non-shrink mortar fills the bed between the lower plate and the pier cap so the vertical force enters the concrete evenly. Voids in the bed make the lower plate bend like a plate spanning a hole, give uneven pressure on the sliding material and can even jam the calotte; manufacturers generally advise a thin bed of flowable mortar. The fittings that lock the plates together for transport must be cut off after the grout has hardened and the girder is seated, or the bearing is locked into a fixed point.
units.model: 平均墊層壓力 σ = N/A。N = 20 MN、下座板 1.3 m×1.3 m = 1.69 m²，σ = 20/1.69 ≈ 11.8 MPa；若邊緣空洞使有效面積只剩 70%，σ ≈ 20/1.183 ≈ 16.9 MPa，且下座板局部受彎。墊層砂漿強度宜取平均壓力的數倍並經設計者核定。數值為教學假設。~Average bed pressure σ = N/A. With N = 20 MN on a 1.3 m×1.3 m lower plate of 1.69 m², σ = 20/1.69 ≈ 11.8 MPa; if edge voids leave only 70% effective area, σ ≈ 20/1.183 ≈ 16.9 MPa and the plate bends locally. The bedding mortar strength should be several times the average pressure, as approved by the designer. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 灌漿前確認高程、水平度與軸線位置，灌漿時由一側連續灌入、另一側溢出以排氣，留取砂漿試體；硬化後敲擊或以預留檢查孔確認無空洞，試體強度達規定值才拆除臨時支撐並切除運輸固定件，切除後拍照存證。~Before grouting confirm elevation, levelness and axis position; pour continuously from one side until mortar emerges on the other to expel air and take mortar specimens; after hardening confirm no voids by tapping or inspection ports, and only when specimens reach the specified strength remove temporary supports and cut the transport fittings, photographing the result.
units.failure: 運輸固定件未切除會讓滑動支承變成固定支承，第一個季節的溫差就在墩頂累積巨大約束力；墊層空洞或以墊片永久承載則造成下座板翹曲、滑動材料偏壓與異常磨耗。~Leaving transport fittings in place turns a sliding bearing into a fixed one, and the first season's temperature change builds large restraint forces at the pier top; bed voids, or shims left as the permanent load path, warp the lower plate and cause eccentric pressure and abnormal wear on the sliding material.
units.misconception: 調整高程用的鋼墊片可以留著當作永久的傳力路徑。~Steel shims used for levelling can stay as the permanent load path.
units.practice: 把「墊層灌漿完成並經檢查」與「運輸固定件切除」列為兩個獨立的停留查驗點，查驗紀錄須含砂漿強度、空洞檢查與切除照片，未經簽認不得拆除臨時支撐或開放載重。~Make completed and inspected bedding grout and removal of transport fittings two separate hold points; records include mortar strength, void checks and photos of the cut fittings, and temporary supports may not be removed nor load applied until both are signed off.

units.anchor: 摩擦係數型式試驗~Friction type test
units.title: 型式試驗與出廠檢驗~Type testing and factory inspection
units.mechanism: 支承的性能來自滑動材料、不鏽鋼面、潤滑與幾何配合的組合，因此要以型式試驗證明一個設計在規定壓力、溫度與滑移速度下的摩擦係數與耐久性，再以出廠檢驗確認每一顆量產支承的尺寸、材料與組裝與型式一致。大型支承常無法整顆試驗，會以縮尺試件做摩擦與耐久試驗、以實尺寸零件做尺寸與材料檢查，業主也可要求抽樣做荷重試驗。~A bearing's performance comes from the combination of sliding material, stainless surface, lubrication and geometric fit, so type tests demonstrate a design's friction coefficient and durability at specified pressure, temperature and sliding speed, and factory inspection confirms each production bearing matches the type in dimensions, materials and assembly. Very large bearings often cannot be tested whole, so friction and endurance tests use scaled specimens while full-size parts are checked for dimensions and materials, and owners may require sample load tests.
units.model: 摩擦係數 μ = H/N。試件在 N = 5 MN 下，常溫啟動水平力 H = 0.12 MN，μ = 0.12/5 = 0.024；−35°C 時 H = 0.20 MN，μ = 0.04。分別小於設計採用的 0.03 與 0.05，判定合格。數值為教學假設。~Friction coefficient μ = H/N. A specimen at N = 5 MN shows a breakaway force H = 0.12 MN at room temperature, μ = 0.12/5 = 0.024, and H = 0.20 MN at −35°C, μ = 0.04. Both are below the design values of 0.03 and 0.05, so the result passes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在試驗前寫好試驗計畫（荷重、溫度、速度、循環數、允收值），由業主代表見證；出廠檢驗量測滑板平整度、球面半徑、滑動材料外露高度與塗裝膜厚，並確認銘牌、預設刻度與運輸固定件位置符合圖面。~Write the test plan beforehand (load, temperature, speed, cycles and acceptance values) and have the owner's representative witness it; factory inspection measures plate flatness, spherical radii, sliding-material protrusion and coating thickness, and checks nameplate, preset scale and transport-fitting positions against the drawings.
units.failure: 若只看產品型錄而未要求針對本案壓力與溫度的試驗證明，實際摩擦可能高於設計值，造成墩頂水平力超過計算；球面半徑加工誤差過大則造成點接觸與黏滑（stick-slip）振動。~Relying on a catalogue without test evidence at the project's pressure and temperature can let actual friction exceed the design value, so pier-top horizontal forces exceed calculation; excessive machining error in the spherical radius causes point contact and stick-slip vibration.
units.misconception: 支承只要額定荷重夠大，任何轉角與溫度下都一定合格。~If a bearing's rated load is high enough, it passes at any rotation and temperature.
units.practice: 合約要求提交型式試驗報告、出廠檢驗報告與材料證明，並把首件檢驗或見證試驗列為停留點；試驗溫度範圍須涵蓋橋址設計最低溫，報告附原始力—位移曲線。~The contract requires type-test reports, factory inspection reports and material certificates, with first-article inspection or witnessed testing as a hold point; the test temperature range must cover the site's design minimum, and reports include raw force–displacement curves.

units.anchor: 位移指標刻度~Movement indicator scale
units.title: 位移指標與溫度回歸~Movement indicator and temperature regression
units.mechanism: 滑動支承側面裝有指針與刻度板，可直接讀出上滑板相對下部的位置；若同時記錄梁體溫度，就能把位移對溫度作線性回歸，斜率應接近 α 乘以距固定點的距離。斜率明顯偏小代表支承黏滯或被卡住，截距逐年漂移則反映潛變乾縮或固定點移動。長大橋常改用拉線式或雷射位移計連續監測，讓支承狀態變成可量化的趨勢資料。~Sliding bearings carry a pointer and scale on the side that show the upper plate's position relative to the lower part; recording girder temperature at the same time lets the engineer regress displacement against temperature, and the slope should be close to α times the distance from the fixed point. A clearly smaller slope means the bearing is sticking or jammed, and an intercept that drifts year by year reflects creep and shrinkage or a moving fixed point. Long bridges often use draw-wire or laser displacement sensors for continuous monitoring, turning bearing condition into quantifiable trend data.
units.model: 理論斜率 k = α·L = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300,000 mm = 3.6 mm/°C；一年量測回歸得 3.4 mm/°C，為理論的 94%。年溫差 45°C 時理論位移 162 mm、實測 153 mm。若斜率降到 1.0 mm/°C，表示大部分熱位移被束制。數值為教學假設。~Theoretical slope k = α·L = 1.2×10⁻⁵×300,000 mm = 3.6 mm/°C; a year of readings regresses to 3.4 mm/°C, 94% of theory. For a 45°C annual range the theoretical travel is 162 mm and the measured 153 mm. A slope falling to 1.0 mm/°C means most thermal movement is restrained. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接時記錄每個支承的刻度讀值、日期、時間與梁溫作為基準；之後每次定期檢查在不同季節讀值並更新回歸，斜率低於理論值某比例（例如 70%）或刻度接近極限時，啟動詳細檢查。~At handover record each bearing's scale reading with date, time and girder temperature as the baseline; at each periodic inspection read it in different seasons and update the regression, triggering a detailed inspection if the slope falls below a set fraction of theory (for example 70%) or the pointer nears its limit.
units.failure: 支承黏滯時，梁體溫度變化先被束制、累積到摩擦力被克服後突然滑動，造成異響與衝擊；若只看單次讀值是否在刻度內，無法察覺這種行為，直到墩頂開裂或伸縮縫損壞。~When a bearing sticks, thermal movement is first restrained, then releases suddenly once friction is overcome, causing noise and shocks; checking only whether a single reading lies within the scale cannot reveal this behaviour until the pier top cracks or the expansion joint is damaged.
units.misconception: 位移指針還在刻度範圍內，就代表支承功能正常。~If the movement pointer is still within the scale, the bearing is working properly.
units.practice: 檢查表要求同時記錄刻度、梁溫與時間，並把同一聯所有支承的讀值一起分析；指針與刻度板要避開排水與積塵位置，必要時加裝可遠端讀取的位移計。~The inspection form requires scale reading, girder temperature and time together, and all bearings of a unit are analysed together; place the pointer and scale away from drainage and dust traps and add remotely readable displacement sensors where needed.

units.anchor: 累積滑移距離~Accumulated sliding path
units.title: 磨耗、腐蝕與防塵保護~Wear, corrosion and dust protection
units.mechanism: 滑動材料的壽命主要由累積滑移距離決定，而不是由季節溫度位移決定：車輛通過時梁端的微小往復位移次數極多，累積下來常遠大於溫度位移。磨耗、潤滑脂乾化、灰塵與砂粒進入滑動面都會加速損耗；鋼座板與錨栓則面對伸縮縫漏水造成的腐蝕。防塵裙、可更換的密封與排水坡度，是延長支承壽命最便宜的手段。~The life of a sliding material is governed mainly by accumulated sliding distance, not by seasonal thermal travel: traffic produces enormous numbers of tiny reciprocating movements at girder ends, which usually add up to far more than thermal movement. Wear, drying grease and dust or grit entering the sliding surface accelerate deterioration, while steel plates and anchors face corrosion from leaking expansion joints. Dust skirts, replaceable seals and drainage falls are the cheapest ways to extend bearing life.
units.model: 溫度日循環 2×8 mm = 16 mm/日，一年約 5.8 m；重車 3,000 輛/日、每輛造成 2×0.3 mm 往復，1.8 m/日，一年約 657 m。合計約 663 m/年，50 年約 33 km；若型式試驗累積滑移能力為 10 km，約 10,000/663 ≈ 15 年即達上限。數值為教學假設。~Daily thermal cycling of 2×8 mm = 16 mm/day gives about 5.8 m per year; 3,000 heavy vehicles a day each causing 2×0.3 mm of reciprocation give 1.8 m/day, about 657 m per year. The total is about 663 m per year, about 33 km in 50 years; if the type-tested sliding capacity is 10 km, the limit is reached in about 10,000/663 ≈ 15 years. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查滑動材料外露高度（以塞規量測其與不鏽鋼面間隙）、不鏽鋼面刮痕、潤滑脂狀態、防塵裙破損與座板鏽蝕；高交通量或鐵路橋可在梁端加裝位移計統計實際累積滑移，與支承規格的累積滑移能力比較。~Periodically inspect sliding-material protrusion (gauge the gap to the stainless sheet), stainless-surface scratches, grease condition, damaged dust skirts and plate corrosion; on heavily trafficked or rail bridges add displacement sensors at girder ends to count actual accumulated sliding and compare with the specified capacity.
units.failure: 滑動材料磨耗到外露高度歸零後，上滑板與材料凹槽邊緣金屬接觸，摩擦急升、不鏽鋼板被刮傷，支承的水平力與噪音同時增加；伸縮縫漏水則讓錨栓與座板鏽蝕，降低更換時拆卸的可行性。~Once the sliding material wears to zero protrusion, the upper plate contacts the groove edge metal to metal, friction jumps and the stainless sheet is scored, increasing both horizontal force and noise; leaking expansion joints corrode anchors and plates and make later removal harder.
units.misconception: 支承的磨耗只取決於季節溫差造成的大位移。~Bearing wear depends only on the large seasonal thermal movements.
units.practice: 交通量高的橋梁在設計階段就以實際交通與梁端位移估算累積滑移，選用相應能力的滑動材料；維護計畫把伸縮縫排水、防塵裙更換與支承檢查排在同一巡檢週期。~For heavily trafficked bridges estimate accumulated sliding from actual traffic and girder-end movement at the design stage and choose a sliding material with matching capacity; the maintenance plan places expansion-joint drainage, dust-skirt replacement and bearing inspection in the same cycle.

units.anchor: 頂升點與更換程序~Jacking points and replacement procedure
units.title: 頂升更換與交接紀錄~Jacking replacement and handover records
units.mechanism: 支承壽命通常短於橋梁，因此設計時就要預留頂升點、千斤頂空間與更換程序：頂升時梁體反力暫時轉到千斤頂，舊支承拆除、新支承就位後再把荷重轉回。萊茵河上 1978 年建成的萊夫艾森橋更換時，新支承必須精準對接留在結構中的既有座板，且尺寸刻意配合原有混凝土承壓條件，而不是單純追求最小尺寸；抗拔索錨與縱橫向止擋則維持不動。這說明更換工程的邊界條件往往由既有結構決定。~Bearings usually have shorter lives than the bridge, so jacking points, jack space and a replacement procedure must be provided at design: during jacking the reaction is temporarily transferred to jacks, the old bearing is removed, the new one placed and the load transferred back. When the bearings of the Raiffeisen Bridge, built over the Rhine in 1978, were replaced, the new bearings had to connect precisely to plates remaining in the structure and were sized to suit the existing concrete bearing conditions rather than to be as small as possible, while the uplift cable anchorages and longitudinal and transverse restrainers stayed unchanged. Replacement boundary conditions are often set by the existing structure.
units.model: 單支承恆載反力 18 MN，以 4 具 8 MN 千斤頂頂升，總能量 32 MN，利用率 18/32 ≈ 56%；每具 4.5 MN、活塞直徑 300 mm（面積 0.0707 m²），油壓 p = 4.5/0.0707 ≈ 63.7 MPa。頂升量限制 3 mm，相鄰支承線高差限制 1 mm。數值為教學假設。~A dead-load reaction of 18 MN is lifted by four 8 MN jacks with 32 MN total capacity, a utilisation of 18/32 ≈ 56%; each jack carries 4.5 MN with a 300 mm piston (area 0.0707 m²), so oil pressure p = 4.5/0.0707 ≈ 63.7 MPa. Lift is limited to 3 mm and the difference between adjacent bearing lines to 1 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 頂升前由設計者核算頂升點局部承壓與梁體附加應力，頂升時以同步油壓系統控制並用百分表或電子位移計監測每點抬升量，達限值立即停止；荷重轉回後量測新支承高程、預設刻度與位移指標，作為新的基準值。~Before jacking the designer checks local bearing at jacking points and added girder stresses; during jacking a synchronised hydraulic system controls the lift while dial gauges or electronic displacement sensors monitor each point, stopping at the limit; after load transfer measure the new bearing's elevation, preset scale and indicator as the new baseline.
units.failure: 未預留頂升點時只能臨時在梁底或墩帽鑽孔加設托架，可能切斷鋼筋或預力鋼腱；千斤頂不同步抬升則讓梁體扭轉、伸縮縫錯位，甚至在相鄰支承產生拔起。~Without designed jacking points, temporary brackets must be drilled into the girder or pier cap, risking cut reinforcement or tendons; unsynchronised jacking twists the girder, misaligns expansion joints and can even lift off adjacent bearings.
units.misconception: 支承更換只要把舊的拆掉、換上同型號的新品即可，不需要設計者介入。~Replacing a bearing just means removing the old one and fitting the same model; no designer involvement is needed.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含支承一覽表、預設紀錄、安裝溫度、灌漿與固定件切除紀錄、型式與出廠試驗報告、位移基準與頂升程序；任何更換由設計者核定頂升計畫並設停留點，由業主代表簽認後才可執行。~Handover documents contain the bearing schedule, preset records, installation temperatures, grouting and fitting-removal records, type and factory test reports, movement baselines and the jacking procedure; any replacement requires a jacking plan approved by the designer with hold points, executed only after the owner's representative signs off.

example: 設計練習：一聯鋼—混凝土複合連續梁，縱向固定點設在中間墩，最遠的活動支承距固定點 L = 180 m，α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C，設計梁溫 −5 至 45°C、參考溫度 20°C。最大伸縮 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×25 = 54 mm，即 ±54 mm，加 ±20 mm 餘裕後滑板行程 ±74 mm。安裝時梁溫 32°C，溫度預設 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×12 ≈ 26 mm（複合梁乾縮另計）。豎向反力 N = 12 MN、滑動材料容許壓力 45 MPa，A = 12/45 ≈ 0.267 m²，D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.58 m。摩擦水平力 H = μN：常溫 0.03×12 = 0.36 MN，低溫啟動 0.05×12 = 0.6 MN，需由墩帽與錨栓承受。若把固定點移到聯的一端使 L = 360 m，行程變為 ±108 mm 加餘裕、預設約 52 mm，滑板與伸縮縫都要加大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: a steel–concrete composite continuous girder has its longitudinal fixed point at a central pier, the farthest sliding bearing is L = 180 m away, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, design girder temperatures run from −5 to 45°C with a 20°C reference. Maximum movement is 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×25 = 54 mm, i.e. ±54 mm, and with ±20 mm margin the plate travel is ±74 mm. Installed at a girder temperature of 32°C, the thermal preset is 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×12 ≈ 26 mm (composite-deck shrinkage added separately). For a vertical reaction N = 12 MN and an allowable sliding pressure of 45 MPa, A = 12/45 ≈ 0.267 m² and D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.58 m. The friction force H = μN is 0.03×12 = 0.36 MN normally and 0.05×12 = 0.6 MN at cold breakaway, to be carried by the pier cap and anchors. Moving the fixed point to one end makes L = 360 m, so travel becomes ±108 mm plus margin and the preset about 52 mm, enlarging both plate and expansion joint. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 二十世紀後半葉，橋梁支承逐漸由鋼製搖軸、滾軸改為以滑動材料搭配轉動元件的高荷重多向轉動支承，球面支承以凹凸曲面同時處理任意方向轉角，適合大反力與大轉角的長跨橋。歐洲以 EN 1337-11（1997）規範運輸、儲存與安裝，EN 1337-7（2004）專門規範球面與圓柱面 PTFE 支承；美國則有 AASHTO LRFD 第 14 章與 AASHTO/NSBA G9.1 鋼橋支承指引。2023 年德國萊茵河上的萊夫艾森橋把磨損的盆式支承換成最大約 120 MN 的球面支承，2024 年啟用的勒沃庫森萊茵河大橋首段則在塔墩下以球面支承承受約 100,000 kN 荷重。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或施工文件。~In the second half of the twentieth century, bridge bearings moved from steel rockers and rollers to high-load multi-rotational bearings that combine sliding materials with rotation elements; the spherical bearing handles rotation in any direction on matched concave and convex surfaces and suits long spans with large reactions and rotations. In Europe EN 1337-11 (1997) covers transport, storage and installation and EN 1337-7 (2004) covers spherical and cylindrical PTFE bearings; in the United States AASHTO LRFD Section 14 and the AASHTO/NSBA G9.1 steel bridge bearing guidelines apply. In 2023 the Raiffeisen Bridge over the Rhine in Germany replaced worn pot bearings with spherical bearings of up to about 120 MN, and the first section of the Leverkusen Rhine bridge, opened in 2024, carries about 100,000 kN on spherical bearings under its pylon. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or construction documents.
facts: 萊夫艾森橋（魏森圖爾姆—諾伊維德）兩座塔墩共 8 個盆式支承更換為球面支承~The Raiffeisen Bridge at Weißenthurm–Neuwied had 8 pot bearings on its two pylon piers replaced by spherical bearings
該橋內側 4 個新支承直徑約 2.4 m、重約 13 t，豎向承載可達 120 MN~Its 4 inner replacement bearings are about 2.4 m in diameter, weigh about 13 t and carry up to 120 MN vertically
該橋外側支承直徑約 1.6 m、重約 4 t，承載約 48 MN~Its outer bearings are about 1.6 m in diameter, weigh about 4 t and carry about 48 MN
萊夫艾森橋建於 1978 年，為全長約 485 m 的三跨斜張橋，主跨約 235 m~The Raiffeisen Bridge, built in 1978, is a three-span cable-stayed bridge about 485 m long with a main span of about 235 m
勒沃庫森萊茵河大橋首段於 2024 年 2 月啟用，塔下球面支承承受約 100,000 kN 荷重~The first Leverkusen Rhine bridge section opened in February 2024, with about 100,000 kN on spherical bearings under the pylon

AASHTO/NSBA G9.1-2022 列高荷重多向轉動支承實務範圍約 200 kip 至 10,000 kip 以上，轉角約 0.04 rad~AASHTO/NSBA G9.1-2022 lists a practical range for high-load multi-rotational bearings of about 200 kip to over 10,000 kip and about 0.04 rad rotation
